info.title: MLP Vector Club API
info.description: A temporary API which allows programmatic access to some existing features of the [MLPVector.Club](https://mlpvector.club) website. Will be superseded by the [next version](https://api.mlpvector.club) whenever its development is finished.

get.description: Information about the server build and about the connection the request came from

commitId.description: Short hash of the deployed commit

get.description: The staff and other non-regular members of the club, ordered by name
Returns rendered HTML for the sidebar's list of upcoming episodes/events

html.description: Winterchilla UI detail, not part of the contract: rendered upcoming items HTML

get.description: List log entries, newest first. Staff only.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Only entries of this type

parameters.name: initiatorId
parameters.description: Only entries made by this user; 0 selects the ones made by the web server

get.description: List every personal color guide appearance of every user, newest first. Staff only.
Get the details of a log entry. Requires staff role

details.description: Winterchilla UI detail: a list of [label, value] pairs describing the log entry, where values may contain HTML (links, images). Prefer `data`.

data.description: The structured data that was logged with the entry (references by ID, old and new values); its keys depend on the entry type

409.description: The entry has no details to show

get.description: Get the details of a useful link. Requires staff role

put.description: Update an existing useful link. Requires staff role

delete.description: Delete a useful link. Requires staff role

get.description: Every useful link in display order, whatever role it is meant for, for managing them. Staff only.

post.description: Create a new useful link. Requires staff role

put.description: Reorder useful links. Requires staff role

list.description: Comma-separated list of useful link IDs in their new order

delete.description: Clear the PHP stat cache. Requires staff role

get.description: Get basic editable details of an appearance. The user must be signed in and have permission to manage the appearance.

403.description: Insufficient permission to manage this appearance

get.description: Allows querying the full library of public appearances (forced pagination)

parameters.name: guide
parameters.description: Determines the guide to search in

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Which page of results to return

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The number of results to return per page

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search query

post.description: Create a new appearance. The user must be signed in and have permission to create appearances in the specified guide (or their personal guide if no guide is given).

guide.description: Guide identifier (staff only). When omitted, the appearance is created in the user's Personal Color Guide

private.description: Whether the appearance should be private

template.description: Whether to apply the default color group template to the new appearance

message.description: Winterchilla UI detail, not part of the contract: confirmation text for its dialog

goto.description: Winterchilla UI detail, not part of the contract: page path of the new appearance

info.description: Winterchilla UI detail, not part of the contract: extra text, e.g. when applying the template failed

get.description: Get all relevant information about an appearance at once, including tags, color groups and cutie marks

put.description: Update an existing appearance's label, notes or private flag. The user must be signed in and have permission to manage the appearance.

private.description: Whether the appearance should be private

appearancePage.description: Whether this request originates from the appearance page; when set, the response will not include 'label', 'newUrl' or 'notes'

newUrl.description: New URL if the label changed

notes.description: Winterchilla UI detail, not part of the contract: rendered HTML of the notes

403.description: Insufficient permission to manage this appearance

delete.description: Delete an appearance. The user must be signed in and have permission to manage the appearance. Pinned appearances cannot be deleted.

403.description: Insufficient permission to manage this appearance

409.description: The appearance is currently pinned and cannot be deleted

post.description: Apply the default color group template to an appearance. The user must have permission to manage the appearance.

cgs.description: Winterchilla UI detail, not part of the contract: rendered HTML of the appearance's color groups

403.description: Insufficient permission to manage this appearance

409.description: Applying the template failed

delete.description: Selectively clear cached files, colors, tags, notes and other data on an appearance. The user must have permission to manage the appearance.

wipeCmTokenized.description: Delete tokenized and rendered cutie mark files

wipeCmSource.description: Delete cutie mark source SVG files

wipeColors.description: color_hex: clear hex values; color_all: delete all colors; all: delete all color groups

wipeTags.description: Remove all tags (only for appearances not in a personal guide)

resetPrivKey.description: Regenerate the appearance's private share token

403.description: Insufficient permission to manage this appearance

get.description: Get the IDs and labels of an appearance's color groups, for reordering. The user must have permission to manage the appearance. Requires at least 2 color groups.

403.description: Insufficient permission to manage this appearance

409.description: Not enough color groups to reorder

put.description: Set the display order of an appearance's color groups. The user must have permission to manage the appearance.

cgs.description: Color group IDs in the desired order
Winterchilla UI detail, not part of the contract: rendered HTML of the appearance's color groups

403.description: Insufficient permission to manage this appearance

422.description: Validation error, e.g. an unknown color group ID was given

get.description: Fetch the sprite file associated with the appearance

parameters.name: hash
parameters.description: Used for cache busting. The latest value is provided by the appearance resource.

200.description: The sprite image at the specified size

403.description: You don't have permission to access this resource

post.description: Upload a new sprite image for an appearance. The user must have permission to manage the appearance. PCG owners are blocked unless they have the appropriate preference enabled.

path.description: URL of the newly uploaded sprite

403.description: Insufficient permission to manage this appearance

422.description: Validation error, e.g. invalid image format or size

delete.description: Remove the sprite image of an appearance, reverting it to the default. The user must have permission to manage the appearance.

sprite.description: Winterchilla UI detail, not part of the contract: path of the default sprite image

204.description: Removed (an implementation without a default sprite image answers this instead of 200; afterwards GET /appearances/{id}/sprite answers 404 there, while Winterchilla serves its default image)

403.description: Insufficient permission to manage this appearance

404.description: Appearance not found, or (when deleting) no sprite file found

get.description: Get the list of appearances that can be related to this one, split into linked and unlinked groups. Unavailable for appearances in personal guides. The user must have permission to manage the appearance.

403.description: Insufficient permission to manage this appearance

409.description: Relations are unavailable for personal guide appearances

put.description: Set the related appearances for this appearance. Unavailable for appearances in personal guides. The user must have permission to manage the appearance.

mutuals.description: IDs (a subset of ids) for which the relation should be marked as mutual

appearancePage.description: Whether this request originates from the appearance page; when set, 'section' is returned

section.description: Winterchilla UI detail, not part of the contract: rendered HTML of the related appearances section, only present when called from the appearance page

403.description: Insufficient permission to manage this appearance

409.description: Relations are unavailable for personal guide appearances

422.description: Relations are unavailable for personal guide appearances, or validation error

get.description: Get the cutie marks associated with an appearance. The user must have permission to manage the appearance.

facing.description: Which way the pony faces (`left` or `right`); null means the mark is symmetrical and applies to either side

deviation.description: Present if the cutie mark is attributed to a deviation

username.description: Present if the cutie mark is attributed to a contributor

rendered.description: URL of the rendered cutie mark image, null when the mark has no SVG file

preview.description: Winterchilla UI detail, not part of the contract: rendered HTML preview of the cutie marks

403.description: Insufficient permission to manage this appearance

put.description: Replace the cutie marks of an appearance (up to 2). The user must have permission to manage the appearance.

cutieMarks.description: List of cutie mark definitions, max 2 items

facing.description: Which way the pony faces (`left` or `right`); null or empty means the mark is symmetrical and applies to either side

attribution.description: How the cutie mark's contributor is attributed

deviation.description: Deviation URL, required when attribution is 'deviation'

username.description: DeviantArt username, required when attribution is 'user'

appearancePage.description: Whether this request originates from the appearance page; affects whether 'html' is returned

html.description: Winterchilla UI detail, not part of the contract: rendered HTML of the cutie marks list, only present when called from the appearance page and cutie marks remain

403.description: Insufficient permission to manage this appearance

422.description: Validation error in one of the cutie mark entries

get.description: Get the tags applied to an appearance as plain text. Unavailable for personal guide and pinned appearances. The user must have permission to manage the appearance.

tags.description: Comma-separated list of tag names

403.description: Insufficient permission to manage this appearance

409.description: Tagging is unavailable for this appearance

put.description: Update the tags applied to an appearance. Unavailable for personal guide and pinned appearances. The user must have permission to manage the appearance.

origTags.description: Comma-separated list of tag names as they were before editing

tags.description: Comma-separated list of the new tag names

403.description: Insufficient permission to manage this appearance

409.description: Relations are unavailable for personal guide appearances

422.description: Tagging is unavailable for this appearance, or validation error

post.description: Upload and sanitize an SVG file for use as a cutie mark, returning the sanitized SVG markup. The user must be signed in and have permission to manage the appearance.

403.description: Insufficient permission to manage this appearance

422.description: SVG data is missing, invalid or too large

get.description: Get the list of shows/episodes that can be linked to an appearance, along with currently linked entries. Staff only.

groups.description: Map of valid show/episode types to their display names

put.description: Set the shows/episodes linked to an appearance. Staff only.

section.description: Winterchilla UI detail, not part of the contract: rendered HTML of the related shows section

post.description: Pin an appearance to the top of its guide. Staff only. Not available for personal guide appearances.

409.description: Appearances in personal guides cannot be pinned

delete.description: Unpin a previously pinned appearance. Staff only. Not available for personal guide appearances.

409.description: Appearances in personal guides cannot be pinned

get.description: Search appearances by label for autocomplete purposes. Returns an empty array if the query or guide is missing.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search query

parameters.name: guide
parameters.description: Guide identifier to search within

babelLabel.description: Winterchilla UI detail, not part of the contract: the label as the site's 'nutshell names' mode shows it

url.description: Winterchilla UI detail, not part of the contract: the page path of the appearance

image.description: Winterchilla UI detail, not part of the contract: URL of the preview image

get.description: Get a list of every appearance in the database (without color group data)

parameters.name: guide
parameters.description: Determines the guide to search in

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: `relevance` is the staff-managed order grouped by tag, `label` is alphabetical, `added` is newest first

get.description: Get the appearances pinned to the top of a guide
Get the minimum information needed to link to an appearance and show a small preview of it
The history of tags being added to and removed from an appearance, newest first. Staff only; personal guide appearances have no history.

tagId.description: The tag may have been deleted since, in which case it no longer resolves

tagName.description: The tag's name at the time of the change; missing on very old entries

added.description: True when the tag was added, false when it was removed

user.description: Who made the change; null when the user no longer exists

404.description: Appearance not found, or it belongs to a personal guide

get.description: Download the appearance's colors as a palette file: `json` is a nested swatch map (appearance, color group, color label to hex; the Illustrator swatch import format) and `gpl` is a GIMP/Inkscape palette. Both are served as attachments. Front ends may also build them from `GET /appearances/{id}/color-groups`.

200.description: The palette file, as an attachment named after the appearance

get.description: A rendered image of the appearance. Combinations: `palette` as `png` (the colors listed next to the sprite), `sprite` as `png` (the uploaded sprite) or `svg` (traced from it), `preview` as `svg` (the four-color preview) and `facing` as `svg` (the body-orientation graphic, colored with the appearance's colors; pick the side with `facing`). Everything else is a 422, a missing sprite a 404. The server may answer with a redirect to a cache-busted URL of the same image.

parameters.name: facing
parameters.description: Only for `type=facing`

404.description: Appearance not found, or it has no sprite

get.description: Download a cutie mark as an SVG attachment: the sanitized, rendered file by default, or the original upload with `source` (staff only).

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Download the original uploaded file instead of the rendered one. Staff only

401.description: `source` was requested but nobody is signed in

403.description: `source` was requested without the staff role, or the appearance is private

404.description: Appearance or cutie mark not found, or the cutie mark belongs to another appearance

get.description: Get all color groups associated with an appearance
Fetch the preview file associated with the appearance

403.description: You don't have permission to access this resource

post.description: Signs the current user out by deleting their session. If 'everywhere' is set, deletes all of the current user's sessions, or (with staff permission) all sessions belonging to a specified target user. If no session cookie is present, this is a no-op that still returns a success response.

everywhere.description: If present, signs out of all sessions instead of just the current one

204.description: Signed out (also returned if the user wasn't signed in to begin with)

403.description: Insufficient permission to sign out another user's sessions

404.description: The specified target user doesn't exist

500.description: Could not remove session information from the database

get.description: Checks the current sign-in/session status. If the DeviantArt access token has expired, this may trigger a background refresh and report that the session is updating. If no session cookie is present, this reports a logged-out status.

updating.description: True if the session's DeviantArt access token is being refreshed in the background

retriesRemaining.description: Number of refresh attempts remaining before an immediate refresh is forced (only present while updating)

deleted.description: True if the user is no longer signed in

loggedIn.description: Sidebar HTML for the signed-in state

get.description: Get a color group's details and its colors. The user must be signed in and either own the appearance's personal guide or be staff.

put.description: Update an existing color group and its colors. The user must be signed in and either own the appearance's personal guide or be staff.

colors.description: Colors belonging to this group. Existing colors should include their id; omitted existing colors are deleted

major.description: Whether to record this as a major change (only for non-personal guide appearances)

reason.description: Reason for the change, required if major is set

appearancePage.description: Whether this request originates from the appearance page; affects which HTML fragments are returned

fullChangesSection.description: When present and major changes apply on the appearance page, wraps the changes HTML in the full changes section

cgs.description: Winterchilla UI detail, not part of the contract: rendered HTML of the appearance's color groups

changes.description: Winterchilla UI detail, not part of the contract: rendered HTML of the major changes section, present when major changes apply and called from the appearance page

update.description: Winterchilla UI detail, not part of the contract: rendered HTML update notice, present when major changes apply and not called from the appearance page

cmList.description: Winterchilla UI detail, not part of the contract: rendered HTML of the cutie marks list, present when called from the appearance page

notes.description: Winterchilla UI detail, not part of the contract: rendered HTML of the appearance's notes, present when not called from the appearance page

422.description: Validation error (errors are reported under label, reason or colors)

delete.description: Delete a color group and its colors. The user must be signed in and either own the appearance's personal guide or be staff.

post.description: Create a new color group with its colors on an appearance. The user must be signed in and have permission to manage the appearance.

major.description: Whether to record this as a major change (only for non-personal guide appearances)

reason.description: Reason for the change, required if major is set

appearancePage.description: Whether this request originates from the appearance page; affects which HTML fragments are returned

cgs.description: Winterchilla UI detail, not part of the contract: rendered HTML of the appearance's color groups

changes.description: Winterchilla UI detail, not part of the contract: rendered HTML of the major changes section, present when major changes apply and called from the appearance page

update.description: Winterchilla UI detail, not part of the contract: rendered HTML update notice, present when major changes apply and not called from the appearance page

cmList.description: Winterchilla UI detail, not part of the contract: rendered HTML of the cutie marks list, present when called from the appearance page

notes.description: Winterchilla UI detail, not part of the contract: rendered HTML of the appearance's notes, present when not called from the appearance page

403.description: Insufficient permission to manage this appearance

422.description: Validation error, e.g. duplicate color group label or invalid color data (errors are reported under label, reason or colors)

get.description: Get the number of entries in each guide
Get the most recent major changes made to appearances in a guide

put.description: Reorder the appearances in a guide's full list. Staff only.

list.description: Appearance IDs in the desired order

ordering.description: Sort order used to render the returned list

html.description: Winterchilla UI detail, not part of the contract: rendered HTML of the full list

get.description: Get the rendered full list of a guide in the requested order, along with the URL of the full list page for that order

html.description: Winterchilla UI detail, not part of the contract: rendered HTML of the full list

stateUrl.description: URL of the full list page in this order

get.description: Download the full color guide export data as a JSON file. Developer permission required.

200.description: The color guide export JSON file

post.description: Trigger a full reindex of the color guide search index. Developer permission required.

get.description: Constants, validation patterns and client settings that the front end needs before it can render forms. The same for every visitor.

vectorApps.description: Choices for the `p_vectorapp` preference, key to label; the empty key means none

get.description: List events, newest first

post.description: Create a new event. Requires staff permissions. Currently always fails. Requires the **staff** role.

get.description: Fetch an event with its entries

put.description: Edit an existing event. Requires staff permissions. Currently always fails. Requires the **staff** role.

delete.description: Delete an existing event. Requires staff permissions. Currently always fails. Requires the **staff** role.

post.description: Finalize an event, locking in the winning entry. Requires staff permissions. Currently always fails. Requires the **staff** role.

post.summary: This method checks whether the current user can submit any more entries
post.description: Check whether the currently logged in user can submit any more entries to this event. Currently always fails.

get.description: Get an entry's details for management purposes. Requires the entry to belong to the current user, or staff permissions.

403.description: Insufficient permissions to manage this entry

put.description: Update an existing entry. Requires the entry to belong to the current user (or staff permissions), and the event must not have ended (unless staff).

link.description: URL of a deviation or Sta.sh submission

entryHtml.description: Winterchilla UI detail, not part of the contract: rendered HTML for the updated entry list item. Other implementations may answer with an empty object

422.description: Validation error with the submitted link, title or preview image

403.description: Insufficient permissions, or the event has ended

delete.description: Delete an existing entry. Requires the entry to belong to the current user (or staff permissions), and the event must not have ended (unless staff).

403.description: Insufficient permissions, or the event has ended

500.description: Database error while deleting the entry

get.description: Get the lazily-loaded preview HTML for an entry. Does not require the user to be signed in.

html.description: Winterchilla UI detail, not part of the contract: rendered HTML of the entry's preview

get.description: The notices that are currently shown on the site
List all notices, including hidden ones. Staff only.

post.description: Create a notice. Staff only.

messageHtml.description: Printable ASCII only; unsafe HTML is stripped

get.description: Get a notice. Staff only.

put.description: Replace a notice's message, end time and type. Staff only.

delete.description: Delete a notice. Staff only.

get.description: Get a rendered HTML list of the current user's unread notifications. Requires authentication

list.description: Winterchilla UI detail, not part of the contract: rendered HTML for the notification list

500.description: The notifications could not be fetched

post.description: Mark one of the current user's notifications as read. Requires authentication

404.description: Notification does not exist or does not belong to the current user

get.description: List the appearances of a user's personal guide, in their display order. Private appearances are listed to everyone but only carry their ID, label and `private: true` unless the visitor is the owner or staff.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Defaults to the visitor's items-per-page preference

canManage.description: Whether the visitor may add and edit appearances in this guide

401.description: The owner keeps the guide private and the visitor is signed out

403.description: The owner keeps the guide private

get.description: The personal guide point history of a user, newest first. Only the user and staff may see it. The history is built on the first request if it does not exist yet.

data.description: Details depending on the change type (post or appearance references, manual grant comment). `by` is only sent to staff.

post.description: Recalculates the Personal Color Guide point history for the specified user. Requires developer permission.

404.description: The specified user does not exist

get.description: Checks whether the specified user is eligible to add a new Personal Color Guide appearance. Fails if PCG appearance creation is disabled for the user, or if they have fewer than 10 available slots.

204.description: The user is allowed to add a new PCG appearance

403.description: PCG appearance creation is disabled for this user

409.description: The user has no available slots left

404.description: The specified user does not exist

get.description: Gets the number of Personal Color Guide slot points the specified user has available to grant (their available points minus the 10 they need to keep). Requires staff permission.

amount.description: The number of points available to be granted to or taken from the user

404.description: The specified user does not exist

post.description: Grants or takes Personal Color Guide slot points from the specified user, recording the change with a comment. Requires staff permission. The resulting available point total cannot go below 10.

amount.description: The (non-zero) number of points to grant (positive) or take (negative)

comment.description: An optional comment explaining the point change

201.description: The points were successfully given or taken

422.description: The specified amount is 0, invalid, or would cause the user's points to go below 10, or the comment is invalid

404.description: The specified user does not exist

get.description: List the requests or reservations of a show as data (the HTML twin is /show/{id}/posts)

post.description: Create a new request or reservation post. Requires the user to be signed in and have permission to post the given kind; reservations additionally require member permission and an available reservation slot.

showId.description: ID of the show entry this post belongs to

imageUrl.description: URL of the image or deviation to post (see POST /posts/check-image for what is accepted)

label.description: What the post is about; required for requests, optional for reservations

type.description: What a request asks for (characters, objects or backgrounds); required for requests, ignored for reservations

postAs.description: Developer-only: post on behalf of another user (by DeviantArt username)

allowNonmember.description: Developer-only: allow posting a reservation on behalf of a non-member

idString.description: Winterchilla UI detail: the element ID of the post on the page

409.description: Reservation limit reached, or the user to post as is not a club member

canForce.description: If true, the request can be retried with allow_nonmember set to post a reservation on behalf of a non-member

422.description: Validation error (image URL, show entry, description, type, user to post as)

get.description: Reload a post's list item, checking whether its image is still available and merging the broken image with a Derpibooru match if possible. Marks the post as broken if its image cannot be found.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: If set to 'profile', renders the list item for the profile page context

parameters.name: cache
parameters.description: If present, cached data may be used when rendering the list item

broken.description: True if the post's image became unavailable and the user lacks staff permission to see the updated list item

li.description: Winterchilla UI detail, not part of the contract: rendered HTML for the post's list item

section.description: CSS selector for the section the list item belongs in

post.description: Reserve a request, or take over an overdue reservation from another user. Requires member permission and signed in user.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Affects which fields are returned in the response

li.description: Winterchilla UI detail, not part of the contract: rendered HTML for the post's list item (when `from` is not 'suggestion')

button.description: Winterchilla UI detail, not part of the contract: rendered HTML for the reserve button (when `from=suggestion`)

pendingReservations.description: Winterchilla UI detail, not part of the contract: rendered HTML for the user's pending reservations (when `from=suggestion`)

409.description: Not a request, already reserved, broken, or reservation limit reached

li.description: Winterchilla UI detail, not part of the contract: rendered HTML for the post's list item (set if already reserved by the current user, or by someone else and not overdue)

422.description: The user to reserve as does not exist

delete.description: Remove a reservation from a post (un-reserve a request, or delete a manually added reservation). Requires member permission and signed in user; staff may act on any post.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: If set to 'profile', includes the user's pending reservations HTML in the response

li.description: Winterchilla UI detail, not part of the contract: rendered HTML for the post's list item, for requests

pendingReservations.description: Winterchilla UI detail, not part of the contract: rendered HTML for the user's pending reservations (when `from=profile`)

409.description: Reservation cannot be removed (must unfinish first)

post.description: Approve a finished post, marking it as locked. Requires member permission, the post to be reserved and finished, and the deviation to be in the club gallery.

li.description: Winterchilla UI detail, not part of the contract: rendered HTML for the post's list item

409.description: Post not reserved/finished, or not in the club gallery

delete.description: Revoke approval of a previously approved post (unlock it). Requires staff permission, and developer permission if the deviation is still in the club gallery.

409.description: Post not approved, or still in the club gallery and user is not a developer

get.description: Get information about a single post for editing purposes. The user must have permission to edit the post (be the requester/reserver, or staff).

put.description: Update an existing post's details (image, label, etc). The user must have permission to edit the post (be the requester/reserver, or staff).

schema.description: Fields are only updated if present and changed from the post's current value

label.description: Description for the post (required for requests)

type.description: Request type, only applicable to requests

postedAt.description: Developer-only: when the post was originally posted/reserved

reservedAt.description: Developer-only: when the request was reserved (requests only)

finishedAt.description: Developer-only: when the post was marked finished

put.description: Mark a post as finished by attaching a deviation as its finished image. Requires member permission, the post to be reserved, and the user to be the reserver or staff.

allowOverwriteReserver.description: Send this when the 409 `retry` response asks for it: lets the reserver change to the deviation's author even though it differs from the current reserver

409.description: Post not reserved, the deviation is already used, or the linked image was submitted by another user

retry.description: If true, the request can be retried with allowOverwriteReserver set

delete.description: Unmark a finished post (remove its finished image), or delete the reservation entirely if `unbind` is set. Requires member permission and the user to be the reserver or staff.

parameters.name: unbind
parameters.description: If present, removes the reservation from the post entirely (or deletes the post if it's a manually added reservation)

remove.description: True if the post was deleted entirely

409.description: Cannot unfinish manually added reservation without unbind

get.description: Locate a post's page/section given its ID, for use with old shortlink-style URLs. Returns either a redirect target (castle/show info) or a `refresh` instruction if the post belongs to the currently viewed show.

parameters.name: showId
parameters.description: ID of the show currently being viewed, to check whether the post belongs to it

refresh.description: Set if the post belongs to the show specified by show_id

castle.description: Set if the post belongs to a different show than show_id

name.description: Formatted title of the post's show

post.description: Clear the broken status of a post after verifying its preview and fullsize images are reachable again, restoring the previous reserver if known. Requires staff permission.

li.description: Winterchilla UI detail, not part of the contract: rendered HTML for the post's list item

409.description: One of the images is still unavailable

post.description: Validate an image URL (deviation or supported external image provider) and return its preview image and title. Requires the user to be signed in.

imageUrl.description: URL of the image/deviation to check

delete.description: Delete a request post. Requires the user to be signed in and either be the original requester (provided it hasn't been reserved yet) or have staff permission.

409.description: Not a request, or already reserved

put.description: Change the image (preview/fullsize) of a post. Requires the user to be signed in, the post to not be locked, and either be the poster (and, if a request, not yet reserved) or have staff permission.

imageUrl.description: New image URL (deviation or supported external image provider)

li.description: Winterchilla UI detail, not part of the contract: rendered HTML for the post's list item (if the post was previously broken)

preview.description: New preview image URL (if the post was not previously broken)

409.description: Post is locked, already reserved, or the image is unavailable

get.description: Get the rendered HTML for a post's finished image, for lazy loading on the page

parameters.name: viewonly
parameters.description: If present, renders the image in a view-only context (without editing controls)

html.description: Winterchilla UI detail, not part of the contract: rendered HTML for the post's finished image

post.description: Add a finished reservation directly on behalf of a user. Requires staff permission.

showId.description: ID of the show entry this reservation belongs to

idString.description: Winterchilla UI detail: the element ID of the post on the page

422.description: Validation error or show entry does not exist

CSRFToken.description: Required for all non-GET requests. The server sets a `CSRF_TOKEN` cookie on every response; its value must be echoed back as a `CSRF_TOKEN` request parameter (query string or body) on subsequent state-changing (POST/PUT/DELETE) requests, or the request will fail with `419` (CSRF token mismatch). This is purely an anti-CSRF measure and is unrelated to user authentication.
